new_jobs.title: Operations Management Specialist
new_jobs.jd: **Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.** Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level. **Job Description** The Operations Management Specialist OMS Program is structured development program designed to equip high potential talent with the operational expertise, leadership capabilities, and strategic mindset required for future management roles within UPS. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Program Overview This program provides participants with hands on experience through structured rotations across key operational functions, including Air Hub and Gateway Operations, Ramp Operation, Air Cargo business operation, Air Service Center, and Air Network Planning. Participants will spend significant time in frontline operational environments, working alongside teams in sorting facilities, on ramp, and within time critical logistics flows. The program is designed to build real operational depth through direct exposure to the pace, complexity, and challenges of the network. Participants will also gain exposure to cross functional teams and compliance training, while developing both operational and leadership capabilities. Learning is further enhanced through project assignments, action based learning, and collaborative engagements to develop well rounded operational expertise. **In Addition To Operational Exposure, The Program Emphasizes** * End to end understanding of transportation network operations * Development of critical thinking and decision-making capabilities * Exposure to cross functional business perspectives across the network * Ownership of impactful projects driving cost, service, and efficiency improvements \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Career Progression Beyond building a strong operational foundation, we are not looking for individuals to simply inherit existing practices. We are looking for future changemakers who can challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives, and drive continuous improvement across the network. Upon successful completion of the program, High performing participants will be positioned for potential progression into supervision and middle management roles in complex operational environments \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ If you are seeking a dynamic work environment and an opportunity to challenge yourself with something new, join us. UPS offers exceptional development and advancement opportunities to help you build a rewarding career. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Candidate Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in any discipline, preferred in Operations Management, Logistics, Aviation Management, Engineering, or related fields * Prior experience in hub operations, airlines, logistics, or fast paced operational environments is an advantage * Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with demonstrated leadership and good communication skills * Innovative, self-motivated mindset with a drive to improve processes and challenge existing ways of working * Ability to travel regionally as part of the training journey * Requires flexibility to work in 24 by 7 shift operations in frontline operational environments including sorting facility, on road and ramp. * Language Requirements: Proficient in English and Mandarin **Employee Type** Permanent UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

new_jobs.title: 【總部】拉亞漢堡-資訊部經理｜帶領自建工程團隊・打造連鎖餐飲數位系統
new_jobs.jd: **工作內容** 這個職位的工作，是把困難留在總部。 拉亞漢堡在全台有 500 多家門市，九成以上是加盟店。我們相信門市的人應該把時間花在客人身上，所以系統要做到門市零學習負擔，難的事由總部扛。資訊部是一支十多人的自建工程團隊，涵蓋前端、後端、數據、網路與資安。這個職位帶領這支團隊，直屬執行長。 策略與方向由執行長決定，你負責落地：把一句話的方向拆成計畫、排優先順序、交付，並把現場的真實狀況帶回來。 【這份工作值得做的地方】 多數連鎖加盟總部給加盟主的，是品牌與供貨。我們想多給一樣：一套讓開店的人更好經營的系統與資料。這件事做成了，有機會改寫這個產業裡總部與加盟主的關係。 * 你的每一項改動會同時進到 500 多家門市，用的人是每天清晨開店的加盟夥伴，和超過百萬名會員 * 加盟夥伴是自己出資開店的人。訂貨少錯一次、對帳少花一小時，就是他們多出來的收入與時間 * 餐飲業很少有總部自己養工程團隊，所以沒有現成答案可以抄，很多題目你會是第一個解的人 * 直屬執行長，團隊十多人，你的決定很快就看得到結果 【你會做的事】 1. 帶領工程團隊，負責分工、人員培養與交付品質。 2. 交付並維運門市與顧客每天使用的系統，包含線上點餐 、門市訂貨、物流、數據與報表。 3. 打通門市、訂貨、倉儲、物流到財務的資訊流，讓一筆銷售不必靠人重打一次。 4. 把銷售資料整理成總部可以直接用來判斷的資訊。 5. 與營運、財務、加盟督導、品牌部門合作，必要時重新設計流程，而不只是把舊流程搬上系統。 6. 負責資訊安全、雲端帳號與廠商管理。 7. 為上線品質與事故處理負責。 【我們怎麼工作】 * 團隊每天用 AI 代理寫程式，測試與部署自動化。App 的改版週期從半年縮到半天 * 小步上線，出錯能馬上回復 * 每一項改動都先看使用者怎麼用 * 後台重效率，前台重溫度。我們不用機器取代店員與客人的互動 * 新的做得比舊的好，就把舊的拿掉，不讓兩套東西並存 【這個職位不適合】 * 主要經驗是採購、網管與廠商管理的人 * 要規格定好才開工的人 * 把導入新科技本身當成績的人 * 希望先擴編再交付的人 **其他條件** 【必要條件】 1. 曾把一套交易型系統帶到正式上線，並負責上線後的事故。點餐、支付、電商結帳、門市系統擇一即可。 2. 帶過工程團隊，有培養出可獨立負責的成員的實例。 3. 有跨部門推動的實例，對象是營運、財務、加盟或門市，其中至少一次是重新設計流程。 4. 能讀懂架構決策並為它負責。 ﻿ 【加分條件】 * 日常工作已使用 AI 工具，且有自己的複核習慣 * 連鎖加盟體系的系統導入經驗 * 訂貨、倉儲或供應鏈系統的整合經驗 * 電子發票、多元支付的實作經驗 * 資安事件處理經驗 餐飲業的經驗不必先有，願意站在早餐尖峰的櫃檯旁邊看就可以。

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - AI Infrastructure
new_jobs.jd: Meta is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution of complex, cross-functional technical programs across one of Meta's core product or infrastructure domains. In this role, you will translate technical strategy into structured program plans, partner with engineering, product, design, data science, and operations teams to define goals and success metrics, and ensure programs are delivered with speed and quality. You will serve as a key connector across functions — navigating ambiguity, managing risk, and communicating clearly with both technical teams and leadership to keep programs on track and aligned to broader business objectives. Technical Program Manager - AI Infrastructure Responsibilities: * Manage end-to-end execution of technical programs across defined workstreams, from scoping and planning through delivery and post-launch review * Translate technical strategy into structured program plans with clearly defined milestones, dependencies, and success metrics leveraging existing program management formats * Identify, document, and communicate risks to milestones and deliverables, and collaborate with technical leads to develop and track mitigation plans * Analyze program data to identify trends, surface blockers, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for the program team * Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, product, design, data science, and operations by facilitating structured decision-making and proactively resolving or escalating conflicts * Develop and execute communication plans that keep stakeholders informed, tailoring content and format to both technical and non-technical audiences including program updates and decision memos * Track and manage interdependencies across concurrent workstreams, reacting quickly to changes and keeping the program team aligned through transitions * Contribute to the TPM community by participating in community events, sharing best practices, and supporting onboarding and hiring efforts * Use AI-enabled tools and workflows to accelerate program planning, documentation, and stakeholder communication while validating outputs for quality and compliance Minimum Qualifications: * 2+ years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or systems engineering, with a track record of delivering technical programs from inception to launch * Experience setting up program structures including milestones, dependency tracking, and risk documentation using established program management frameworks * Experience identifying and communicating program risks and supporting the development of mitigation plans with cross-functional teams * Experience driving cross-functional collaboration across engineering, product, and operations teams, including proactive conflict resolution and stakeholder alignment * Experience collecting and analyzing program data to identify trends and translate insights into actions that advance program goals Preferred Qualifications: * Experience building or refining program management templates, processes, or documentation practices that improved consistency or efficiency across a team * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience using AI tools to accelerate program workflows such as documentation, risk analysis, or stakeholder communication, with demonstrated ability to validate outputs and apply responsible AI practices * Experience tailoring written communications — such as program updates, decision memos, or executive briefings — to both technical and non-technical audiences at varying levels of the organization * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Experience contributing to TPM community initiatives such as onboarding programs, hiring processes, or knowledge-sharing forums About Meta: Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

new_jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Tech Product Manager** At Good Finance, we are committed to empowering individuals to turn their visions into reality, creating greater value and a better future for society. Driven by a passion for financial technology, we aim to be a trusted force that helps people achieve their dreams. By focusing on professionalism and precision, we transform our expertise into meaningful, long-term support for our clients. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Good Finance offers a distinctive environment that prioritizes innovative solutions while maintaining the highest ethical standards. Our Technology Product Division is the engine of our creativity, and as a Tech Product Manager, you will not just imagine a better financial future—you will build it. We are looking for a partner to bridge the gap between business, design, and technology, redefining what is possible in finance. We believe in continuous learning, open knowledge-sharing, and constant optimization of our products and services. Together, we strive to provide secure, reliable financial solutions and help our clients live better, more confident lives. **Position Overview** We are seeking a curious, passionate, and experienced Tech Product Manager to lead the development of world-class fintech tools. In this role, you will stand at the intersection of business strategy and user experience, analyzing market trends and competitive landscapes to craft a compelling product vision. You will identify strategic opportunities and propose innovative concepts that not only meet evolving market needs but also empower our clients to make smarter financial decisions. Working intimately with cross-functional partners—including design, engineering, data, and compliance teams—you will drive the entire product lifecycle from concept to launch. You will be responsible for translating abstract ideas into detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user flows, ensuring technical feasibility without compromising on usability. Your ability to coordinate across legal, operations, and risk departments will be crucial in delivering high-quality solutions that align with our business goals and regulatory frameworks. As a product champion, you will foster a culture of data-driven innovation. You will leverage user behavior data and collaborate with data scientists to apply AI and machine learning, optimizing conversion funnels and delivering personalized experiences. Your "challenger mindset" will encourage the team to question the status quo, ensuring that our products remain compliant, secure, and deeply human-centered in a rapidly changing digital landscape. **Key Responsibilities** * **Product Strategy:** Analyze financial market trends, user behavior, and competitive landscapes to craft a compelling product vision and roadmap. * **Design & Documentation:** Create and maintain detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), feature specs, workflows, and UX/UI wireframes. * **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Coordinate across design, engineering, legal, finance, operations, and risk teams to ensure product feasibility and alignment with business goals. * **Lifecycle Management:** Drive the entire product lifecycle—from concept and development to testing, launch, and continuous iteration. * **Data-Driven Optimization:** Leverage data on user behavior and conversion funnels to continuously optimize the user experience; work with data scientists to apply AI/ML for smarter risk management and personalization. * **Regulatory Compliance:** Partner with internal compliance teams and regulators to ensure products adhere to financial regulations (AML, KYC, data privacy) and navigate the legal landscape confidently. **What You’ll Gain** * Be part of an open, warm, and curious team that values shared growth. * Room to explore, innovate, and experiment in the Fintech Product domain. * Contribute to building a trustworthy, user-centered financial ecosystem. * Gain exposure to the intersection of AI, finance, and design, seeing how technology creates better lives. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Design, or a related field. * 5+ years of experience in fintech product management. * Solid technical literacy; new_jobs.jd: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. **The Role** The Field Application Engineer (FAE) / Solutions Architect in this position will drive customer adoption of AMD component technologies for APJ-TW region by providing end-to-end technical engagement spanning pre-sales consultation, partner and customer enablement, and post-sales issue management. This role focuses on supporting AMD component business including AMD Ryzen™ processors, AMD Radeon™ graphics, and AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ processors across consumer, commercial, gaming, workstation, and channel markets. The individual will identify business opportunities and target customers, work closely with Sales and business partners to qualify opportunities, and provide technical guidance on product positioning, platform compatibility, performance tuning, system configuration, and competitive differentiation. The role also supports partner training, ecosystem enablement, system integration readiness, and field escalation management. In addition, this role will support AI-related workloads on AMD client and workstation platforms, including advising on use cases involving local AI inference, content creation, model development workflows, and GPU-accelerated computing. Familiarity with AMD AI software ecosystem concepts, including basic ROCm knowledge, is considered a plus for supporting emerging AI opportunities and customer discussions. **The Person** This position requires a strong technical understanding of PC component platforms and the ability to guide customers and partners from evaluation through deployment. The ideal candidate should be comfortable supporting a broad set of AMD component products and ecosystems, including CPUs, GPUs, motherboards, BIOS/UEFI, drivers, and operating systems. The ideal candidate should also have an interest in AI market trends and practical understanding of AI-related workloads on client, workstation, or edge platforms. Background or experience related to AI, machine learning, accelerated computing, or GPU-enabled software environments is preferred. Working knowledge of ROCm is nice to have. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide pre-sales technical consultation on AMD Ryzen CPU, Radeon GPU, and Ryzen Threadripper platforms * Support design-in, validation, and deployment for desktop, gaming, workstation, and commercial platforms * Deliver technical training and presentations to channel partners and customers * Troubleshoot CPU, GPU, BIOS, driver, and platform-level issues and manage escalations * Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and marketing teams to share field feedback * Support customer and partner discussions related to AI workloads, including local inference, AI workstation usage, GPU acceleration, and platform readiness for AI applications * Provide basic technical guidance on AMD AI software ecosystem topics and coordinate with internal experts when deeper ROCm or AI framework support is required **Preferred Experience** Strong experience in customer-facing technical roles with PC component platforms, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage complex cross-functional technical issues. Must be well versed in the software ecosystem in one or more areas including OS, compilers, libraries, debug tools, development tools, SW applications, validation workloads, and driver/WHQL validation; experience using issue tracking systems (e.g., JIRA) is preferred Background or experience related to AI workloads, machine learning applications, AI PC or AI workstation environments, and GPU-compute use cases is preferred. Exposure to ROCm, AI software frameworks, or accelerated computing environments is considered a plus. **Academic Credentials** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with 8+ years of relevant experience. *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. new_jobs.company: 創智生物科技股份有限公司
new_jobs.jd: Clinical Research & Product Strategy Manager Company: 創智生物科技股份有限公司 Location: Taipei, Taiwan | On-site | Full-time | 1 opening Salary: Negotiable, based on relevant capabilities and experience. Reports to: Chief Strategy Officer and General Manager About the role We are a medical device company seeking a manager who can turn clinical research into product and market decisions. Working with the Chief Strategy Officer, General Manager and physicians, you will lead literature appraisal, research collaboration and product evaluation to support product introduction and market validation. A project assistant will be assigned to work under your supervision, with support from the heads of Administration and Sales. Six required capabilities and responsibilities The first four capabilities require concrete evidence of your own work. Paper appraisal, evidence synthesis and communicating the findings to physicians are priority screening criteria. 1. Critical paper appraisal: Assess study design, population, intervention, comparator, outcomes and limitations; interpret basic statistics and determine whether findings apply to our products and target markets. 2. Clinical evidence synthesis: Integrate multiple papers into conclusions that support physician discussions and company decisions. Clearly distinguish supported findings, unsupported claims and evidence gaps, and turn the findings into clear physician-facing explanations. 3. Regulatory literacy: Identify relevant product classification, intended use, authorization requirements and claim boundaries, and recognize where regulatory specialists are needed. 4. Physician research collaboration: Clarify research questions, study design, endpoints, feasibility, budget and timelines with physicians, professors and academic partners; write applications for government-funded research projects and coordinate research execution. 5. Product portfolio development: Identify products from clinical needs, compare manufacturers and competitors, evaluate costs and introduction requirements, and develop a coherent product portfolio and business model. 6. Market validation after research: Translate findings into physician education, pilot or trial-use plans and channel materials. Conduct site visits and product presentations, and validate willingness to pay and adoption requirements. Additional required experience and skills - Experience in research collaboration and writing applications for government-funded, industry–academia or NSTC research projects; be able to explain your personal contribution. - Research design and basic statistical interpretation, with the ability to discuss endpoints, controls, sample-size assumptions and feasibility with clinicians and statisticians. - Understanding of IRB/GCP research ethics and submission processes; ability to coordinate submissions, responses, amendments and relevant documentation. No specific certificate is mandatory. - Research data quality management: check completeness, consistency, missing data and anomalies, coordinate resolution and protect confidential data. - Government research project execution and closeout: coordinate review responses, supplementary documents, amendments, progress and final reports, and work with partners and finance on reimbursement and expense documentation. - Mandarin communication and research proposal writing; English proficiency sufficient to search and critically read international papers and journals. Working proficiency in documents, presentations, spreadsheets and literature search tools. - Bachelor's degree or above in biomedical science, life science, medicine, public health or a related research field. Qualifications will be assessed together with demonstrated capabilities. Preferred qualifications - Industry–academia collaboration contract and intellectual property concepts. - Clinical research participant enrollment experience is a plus, not a core requirement. - Medical device research or commercialization experience, and formal IRB/GCP or research methods training. How to apply and interview process Please submit your resume and a brief description of one or more relevant projects you personally worked on, covering the problem, your contribution and the outcome. During the selection process, we will review your experience in paper appraisal, evidence synthesis, regulatory application and physician research collaboration. Our selection process includes two interviews. Use public or anonymized information only; do not disclose patient information or confidential employer materials. If prior work cannot be shared, you may demonstrate your capabilities through a discussion or exercise using public materials. 臨床研究與產品策略經理 公司：創智生物科技股份有限公司 工作地點：台北辦公室上班｜全職｜需求 1 名 薪資：面議，依相關能力與經驗議定。 回報對象：策略長、總經理 職務目的 我們正在尋找一位能把臨床研究轉成產品與市場決策的夥伴。你將與策略長、總經理及醫師合作，主導文獻判讀、研究合作與產品評估，推動產品導入及市場驗證。公司將配置一位專案助理，由你帶領，管理部與營業部主管也會提供支援。 六項必要能力與主要工作 前四項必須有本人實際能力證據。paper 判讀、文獻整合及把研究轉成醫師能理解的說明，是優先篩選門檻。 1. 判讀 paper：看懂研究設計、對象、介入、對照、結果及限制，判讀基本統計，評估證據是否適用於公司產品與目標市場。 2. 整理臨床證據：整合多篇文獻，形成醫師能討論、公司能決策的結論；清楚指出支持什麼、不能支持什麼及證據缺口，轉成醫師關心的溝通內容。 3. 讀懂相關法規：辨識產品分類、預期用途、許可要求與宣稱界線，知道哪些部分需要法規專業人員協助。 4. 協助醫師推動研究：與醫師、教授及學術單位釐清研究問題、研究設計、評估指標、執行條件、預算與進度，撰寫政府計畫申請案，並協調研究執行。 5. 建立完整產品線：從臨床需求尋找產品，比較原廠與競品，評估成本及導入條件，形成具一致定位的產品組合與商業模式。 6. 研究後的市場驗證：將成果轉成醫師教育、試用方案與通路工具，進行院所拜訪及產品演說，驗證付費需求與採用條件。 其他必要經驗與技能 - 具研究合作及撰寫政府計畫申請案的能力，包含政府研究、產學合作或國科會計畫，並能說明本人負責的工作與成果。 - 理解研究設計與基本統計判讀，能與醫師及統計人員討論研究指標、對照方式、樣本數假設及可行性。 - 了解 IRB 人體研究倫理審查與 GCP 臨床研究規範，能協調送審、審查回覆、補件、變更及文件管理；無指定必要證照。 - 具研究資料品質管理能力：檢查完整性、一致性、缺漏與異常，協同團隊處理並保護機密資料。 - 具政府研究計畫執行與結案能力：協調審查回覆、補件、變更、進度與成果報告，配合合作單位及財務辦理請款、核銷文件。 - 中文可撰寫研究計畫與專業溝通；英文可搜尋及判讀國際論文與期刊。熟悉文書、簡報、試算表及文獻搜尋工具。 - 大學以上，生醫、生命科學、醫療、公共衛生等研究相關背景；須同時具備可說明的實際能力。 加分條件 - 了解產學合作契約與智慧財產權概念。 - 具臨床研究收案經驗加分，非主要能力或必要條件。 - 具醫療器材研究、研究成果商業化經驗，或 IRB／GCP、研究方法相關正式訓練。 應徵方式與面試流程 請提供履歷，並簡述一案或以上你親自參與的相關案例，說明當時的問題、你的工作及成果。甄選過程中，我們會進一步確認文獻判讀、證據整合、法規應用與醫師研究合作的實際經驗。 甄選採兩階段面試。請使用公開或去識別資料，不提供病人資料或前雇主機密。若既有成果不便分享，可在甄選時以公開資料進行討論或實作。
